name: mws-s3-mcp-ai-cli
description: MWS Cloud Platform S3 backups for Cursor: find and restore a file from a backup, see where the bucket's space goes. Read-only: the bundled server cannot write, delete or move objects.

MWS_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.title: MWS Cloud Platform S3 access key ID
MWS_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: S3 access key ID; a key scoped to the backup buckets is enough.

MWS_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.title: MWS Cloud Platform S3 secret access key
MWS_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: S3 secret access key for that key ID.

MWS_S3_POOL.title: MWS Cloud Platform S3 pool
MWS_S3_POOL.description: Pool (region) of the bucket; it sets both the endpoint and the signing region.
